import heapq


def pass_route(n: int, edges: list[list[int]], stations: list[list[int]], prices: list[int]) -> int:
    k = len(prices)
    full_mask = (1 << k) - 1

    graph = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for u, v, cost, zone in edges:
        graph[u].append((v, cost, zone))
        graph[v].append((u, cost, zone))

    station_masks = [0] * n
    for stop, zone in stations:
        station_masks[stop] |= 1 << zone

    inf = float("inf")
    dist = [[inf] * (1 << k) for _ in range(n)]
    dist[0][0] = 0
    pq = [(0, 0, 0)]  # cost, stop, owned-pass mask

    while pq:
        spent, u, mask = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if spent != dist[u][mask]:
            continue

        if u == n - 1:
            return spent

        available = station_masks[u] & ~mask
        subset = available
        while subset:
            new_mask = mask | subset
            extra = 0
            bits = subset
            while bits:
                bit = bits & -bits
                extra += prices[bit.bit_length() - 1]
                bits -= bit

            new_spent = spent + extra
            if new_spent < dist[u][new_mask]:
                dist[u][new_mask] = new_spent
                heapq.heappush(pq, (new_spent, u, new_mask))

            subset = (subset - 1) & available

        for v, cost, zone in graph[u]:
            ride_cost = 0 if zone != -1 and (mask & (1 << zone)) else cost
            new_spent = spent + ride_cost
            if new_spent < dist[v][mask]:
                dist[v][mask] = new_spent
                heapq.heappush(pq, (new_spent, v, mask))

    return -1
